## Problem

What child-process security problem is not handled well today?

## Proposed API or behavior

Show the smallest API or policy change that would solve it.

## Security impact

Explain whether the proposal weakens any default, requires an explicit opt-in or only improves diagnostics.

## Alternatives considered

List existing shellcage features that almost solve the problem.

## Compatibility

Describe impact on Node.js 18, ESM, CommonJS, TypeScript declarations, CLI output and stable error codes.
